clue.text: Established procedure at home

parts.note: a habit is a settled, regular way of doing something

explanation.surface: A routine that someone always follows when they are at home.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Established procedure at' reads as one phrase, but the definition is just the final word.
explanation.definitionFit: Synonym: the natural surroundings where an animal or plant lives are its home.

clue.text: Appropriate whilst in transit

parts.note: to appropriate is to seize; the word describes seizing a vehicle, plane or cargo while it travels

explanation.surface: Taking something while on the move.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Appropriate' looks like the adjective meaning suitable but is the verb meaning seize.
explanation.definitionFit: Description: to seize control of an aircraft or vehicle, or steal goods, during a journey.

clue.text: Exclude fellow drinks seller

parts.note: to bar someone is to exclude them
a fellow is a man

explanation.surface: Banning a man who sells alcohol.
explanation.definitionFit: Description: a man who serves drinks behind the counter of a pub.

clue.text: Have one go then another almost, let out and capsize

parts.note: to have a go is to take a turn

indicators.note: almost means the word is not quite complete, so its last letter is dropped

parts.note: another go is a second turn

indicators.note: out signals the letters of let are put out of their order

explanation.surface: Taking a go, then nearly another, before releasing and overturning.
explanation.walkthrough: 'almost' trims TURN to TUR; 'out' turns LET into TLE.
explanation.definitionFit: Idiom: a boat that turns upside down in the water is said to capsize this way.

clue.text: Employment Exchange

definitions.meaning: one's line of work or craft

explanation.surface: An Employment Exchange was the old name for a jobcentre.
explanation.walkthrough: The surface reads as one name, the British Employment Exchange where jobseekers once went; split it into two words.
explanation.definitionFit: One word for a skilled occupation and for commerce or swapping goods.

clue.text: One in form maybe always allowed outside

indicators.note: the word for allowed sits outside, wrapping the word for always

parts.note: to let is to allow
ever means always, as in 'ever hopeful'

explanation.surface: Someone always permitted to stay outside, perhaps a pupil in a school form.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Form' suggests a school class, but a hare's resting hollow is called its form, and a young hare lies in one.
explanation.definitionFit: Example: a young hare rests in a form, the shallow hollow a hare makes in grass; 'maybe' flags an example.

clue.text: Way of living provided in the French fashion

indicators.note: in places the word for provided inside the French article

parts.note: le is the masculine form of 'the' in French
provided means if, as in 'provided it rains'
style is a synonym of fashion

explanation.surface: A way of life that comes in the French manner.
explanation.definitionFit: Synonym: the manner in which a person habitually lives, works and spends time.

clue.text: Farewell from man-servant short of time

indicators.note: short of means lacking, so the letter for time is removed

parts.note: a valet is a gentleman's personal man-servant

explanation.surface: A man-servant without enough time to say goodbye.
explanation.definitionFit: Latin word for goodbye, used in English for a formal parting.

clue.text: Easy-to-make money Michael's reported

parts.note: the ready is slang for cash

indicators.note: reported means spoken, so the word is taken by its sound

parts.note: Mick is a short form of Michael, so Michael's is Mick's

explanation.surface: Michael's money is said to be easily earned.
explanation.walkthrough: 'the ready' (ready money) is British slang for cash in hand.
explanation.definitionFit: Description: a premixed preparation, such as for concrete or cake, needs only water added, so it is simple to make.

clue.text: Standing a round perhaps giving medical care

definitions.meaning: paying for others' drinks, as when buying a round in a pub

explanation.surface: Someone standing on a round of visits to give medical care, like a doctor.
explanation.walkthrough: To stand a round is British pub talk for buying everyone a drink.
explanation.definitionFit: One word covers paying for another's pleasure and caring for a patient medically.

clue.text: Junior detains our unruly panellist

indicators.note: the abbreviation holds the shuffled letters inside it, as a gaoler detains a prisoner
unruly letters are out of order, so the word our is rearranged

explanation.surface: A young person holds back a disorderly member of some panel.
explanation.walkthrough: 'unruly' rearranges OUR to URO, and 'detains' signals the container; 'panellist' is a jury member, not a TV pundit.
explanation.definitionFit: A member of a jury is one of a panel of people sworn to decide a verdict.

clue.text: Branch with a leaf if it mutated

indicators.note: mutated means changed in form, so these letters are rearranged

parts.note: taken as written
taken as written
taken as written

explanation.surface: A tree branch whose leaf has changed through mutation.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Branch' looks botanical alongside 'leaf', but it means an associated organisation.
explanation.definitionFit: Synonym: a branch of a larger organisation, such as a local office or subsidiary, is an affiliated body.

clue.text: Drink cures heart that's broken

indicators.note: a broken arrangement of letters is reassembled in a new order

parts.note: taken as written
taken as written

explanation.surface: A drink that mends a broken heart.
explanation.definitionFit: Example: a green or yellow French liqueur made by Carthusian monks is a kind of drink.

clue.text: Membrane with some transparency still

indicators.note: some says the answer is a run of letters hidden inside the words that follow

parts.note: the letters run across the end of one word into the next

explanation.surface: A thin layer that still keeps some of its see-through quality.
explanation.definitionFit: Loose synonym: a sac or bladder formed of membranous tissue, holding fluid in the body.

clue.text: Piece of furniture and where to find it

definitions.text: Piece of furniture and where to find it

parts.note: a bed is a piece of furniture
a chamber, a room, is where a piece of furniture is found

explanation.surface: An item of furniture and its location.
explanation.walkthrough: The whole clue is both the definition and the wordplay: the furniture, then the room it stands in.
explanation.definitionFit: Description: a sleeping room, an old word for the room holding the bed.

clue.text: Nonconformist priest nearby indisposed

indicators.note: indisposed means out of sorts, so the letters are put out of order

parts.note: taken as written
taken as written

explanation.surface: A priest living close by who has been taken ill and dissents from the Church.
explanation.walkthrough: In Britain, a Nonconformist is a Protestant outside the Church of England.
explanation.definitionFit: Example: a member of a Protestant church governed by elders is one of the English Nonconformist denominations.

clue.text: Jammed cylinder

parts.note: jammed suggests stuck, but means filled with jam; the cylinder is a rolled sponge cake

explanation.surface: A cylinder that has stuck fast, as in an engine.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Jammed' suggests stuck machinery, but here it means filled with jam.
explanation.definitionFit: Description: a sponge cake spread with jam and rolled into a cylinder.

clue.text: Uneasiness, daughter is quite perturbed

indicators.note: perturbed means thrown into disorder, so these letters are rearranged

explanation.surface: A daughter who is rather troubled, feeling uneasy.
explanation.definitionFit: Synonym: a feeling of anxiety or worry.

clue.text: More tough playful critters

indicators.note: playful letters frolic out of order and are rearranged

explanation.surface: Frisky creatures that are tougher than others.
explanation.definitionFit: Comparative synonym: more severe or rigorous in enforcing rules.

clue.text: News that makes sense

definitions.meaning: information gathered, especially by spies or the military

explanation.surface: Reports that are actually coherent.
explanation.definitionFit: One word covers both senses: secret information gathered, and the mental capacity to understand things.

clue.text: Restaurant purchased by pub is troublesome

indicators.note: purchased by says the answer is a run of letters hidden inside the words that follow

parts.note: the letters run across the end of one word into the next

explanation.surface: An eating place bought by a pub that is a nuisance.
explanation.definitionFit: Example: a small, informal eating place, often French in style.

clue.text: Reveal occasionally sunny view I initially loved

indicators.note: occasionally means every other one, so alternate letters are taken
initially means the first letter of the following word

explanation.surface: Uncovering a sometimes-sunny vista I loved at first sight.
explanation.walkthrough: 'occasionally' takes the even letters of 'sunny view': U, N, V, E.
explanation.definitionFit: Synonym: to remove a covering, making something known or visible.

clue.text: Question Liz not starting grill

indicators.note: the name Liz loses the letter it starts with

explanation.surface: Asking Liz something when she has not begun to cook on the grill.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Question' looks like the definition but supplies the abbreviation; the definition is 'grill', meaning interrogate.
explanation.definitionFit: Synonym: to grill someone is to interrogate them closely with a stream of questions.

clue.text: Growth polluted a coastline

indicators.note: polluted letters are spoilt and mixed up, so they are rearranged

parts.note: taken as written

explanation.surface: An increase in contamination along a stretch of coast.
explanation.definitionFit: Synonym: an increase or rapid intensification, as when a conflict or cost keeps growing.

clue.text: Space around north for scene of conflict

indicators.note: the word for space goes around the letter for north

parts.note: an area is a space or region

explanation.surface: A space up north where fighting takes place.
explanation.definitionFit: Synonym: a field of contest, from the sandy Roman amphitheatre where gladiators fought.

clue.text: Ship's freight about to be removed

indicators.note: to be removed means the letter for about is taken out

parts.note: cargo is goods carried as freight
C, from Latin circa, is an abbreviation for about

explanation.surface: The goods carried on a vessel are about to be unloaded.
explanation.walkthrough: 'about to' reads as a phrase, but 'about' gives C and 'to be removed' takes it out.
explanation.definitionFit: Example: the vessel Jason sailed in Greek myth to fetch the Golden Fleece.

clue.text: Come between Italian footballers and model?

parts.note: Inter Milan is a famous Italian football club, commonly called Inter
to model is to pose, as for an artist

explanation.surface: Something separating players from Italy and a fashion model.
explanation.definitionFit: Synonym: to place oneself or something in the middle, intervening between two parties.

clue.text: Take the plunge with cricketer here on vacation

parts.note: a bat is a batsman in cricket

indicators.note: the word here is vacated, emptied of its middle so just its outer letters stay

explanation.surface: Deciding to commit while a cricket player is away on holiday here.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Take the plunge' usually means commit to something; here it is literal, going into water.
explanation.definitionFit: Literal reading: to plunge into the sea or a pool is to go swimming.

clue.text: Confusion of slave hiding cocktail of rum

indicators.note: the word for slave wraps around the mixed letters, hiding them

parts.note: to slave is to toil

indicators.note: a cocktail is a mixture, so the letters of rum are mixed

explanation.surface: A muddled servant secretly mixing a rum drink.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Slave' looks like a noun but is the verb, to work hard; 'cocktail of' rearranges RUM to URM, held inside by 'hiding'.
explanation.definitionFit: Synonym: a state of great disturbance, chaos or uproar.

clue.text: Fan display that is not so hot

parts.note: to air something is to display it publicly
cool means somewhat less than warm

explanation.surface: An enthusiast's display that is rather lacklustre.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Fan' reads as a supporter, but here it is the verb: blow air on something to chill it.
explanation.definitionFit: To fan an engine or room is to chill it with a current of moving air.
